dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: #Hello, {NICKNAME}. If you'd like to speak with me, then you'll have to cough up some Mora first.

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: Just kidding, just kidding! Hehe, I just wanted to see how you'd react, that's all.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you like it here?

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: Ahem, well, even though it's nothing compared to the Palace of Alcazarzaray...

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: I suppose it could suffice as my backup base. It'll do.

choices.text: "It'll do"? C'mon, it's gotta be better than that...

response.speaker: Dori
response.text: Puh-lease, merely receiving a compliment from the wise and mighty Lord Sangemah Bay...

response.speaker: Dori
response.text: Is already high praise indeed!

response.speaker: Dori
response.text: You're certainly a cut above the average artless toadstool!

response.speaker: Dori
response.text: But, if the knowledgeable Lord Sangemah Bay is to serve as a renovation consultant for this place...

response.speaker: Dori
response.text: You'll need some Mora, a LOT of Mora...

response.speaker: Dori
response.text: No rush, though. I'm sure you'll save enough Mora... someday.

response.speaker: Dori
response.text: I suppose I might stay here a little longer, now that there's an opportunity to earn big Mora, hehe.

choices.text: How do I take it from "It'll do" to "It's amazing"?

response.speaker: Dori
response.text: Oh? You mean... you mean, what'll it take for it to beat the Palace of Alcazarzaray as my primary base?

response.speaker: Dori
response.text: Wow, good to see my young apprentice show some ambition for once.

response.speaker: Dori
response.text: Really, I'm impressed!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Want to chat?

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: I most certainly would!

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: The question is, have you brought enough Mora?

choices.text: Uh, why are you so obsessed with Mora?

response.speaker: Dori
response.text: Well, first and foremost, I'm a merchant.

response.speaker: Dori
response.text: Second, Mora is shiny, round, and mesmerizing!

response.speaker: Dori
response.text: And third, only if you truly adore Mora will it always come running your way.

response.speaker: Dori
response.text: So, work hard and cherish every Mora you make.

response.speaker: Dori
response.text: That way, I can stay by your side and keep earning Mora from you forever.

response.speaker: Dori
response.text: Well, whaddya waiting for? Get out there and chase that Mora!

choices.text: Why do you want to make so much Mora?

response.speaker: Dori
response.text: Because Mora is the loveliest thing in the whole world!

response.speaker: Dori
response.text: And I don't want to lose anything precious to me again due to a lack of Mora... Never again...

response.speaker: Dori
response.text: Ahem, anyway, Mora can solve most of life's problems.

response.speaker: Dori
response.text: And if you ever find a problem that Mora can't fix, just try doubling the amount you're offering!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is there anything you'd like to do?

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: Yeah, let's work together and make a big, shiny, golden statue and place it out where everyone can see!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So is this your recommendation as my new "renovation consultant"?

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: That's right. I've been thinking about what this place is lacking...

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: And then it hit me. What's missing is more shiny gold! Hehe!

choices.text: In that case... why don't we make a golden Dori statue?

response.speaker: Dori
response.text: Well, if you really insist!

response.speaker: Dori
response.text: But maybe we should wait until you can afford the rights to use my image.

response.speaker: Dori
response.text: For now, we can start with a simple Mora sculpture!

response.speaker: Dori
response.text: Because this place could potentially serve as my base, naturally, it should be to my liking!

response.speaker: Dori
response.text: #But let's get one thing straight: This is a collaboration between {NICKNAME} and the eminent Lord Sangemah Bay.

response.speaker: Dori
response.text: So you better bring your best to the project.

response.speaker: Dori
response.text: I prepared all the tools and raw gold a few days ago. Anyway, I'll cover the expenses this time, as long as you perform the labor!

response.speaker: Dori
response.text: Okay okay, enough idle chitchat.

response.speaker: Dori
response.text: Come talk to me when you're ready to get to work.

choices.text: How about... we make a shiny, golden Mora sculpture?

response.speaker: Dori
response.text: Haha, at long last, my tastes are beginning to rub off on you, my young apprentice!

response.speaker: Dori
response.text: Alright, we'll make a Mora sculpture!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good morning, Dori.

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: Good morning, my young apprentice.

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: A successful day starts with the morning. That Mora's not gonna earn itself, after all.

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: So c'mon, let's get moving!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good night, Dori.

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: Good night, my young apprentice.

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: I hope you have a nice dream filled with shiny Mora.

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: Ho-ho, nothing can compare to my darling Mora, but the gemstones here are beautifully lustrous.

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: The longer you spend in my company, the more astute your tastes grow, my apprentice. How very wonderful.

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: I, the magnanimous Lord Sangemah Bay, have decided that I will be staying here for a little longer. No need to thank me — I know you must feel honored, and that's enough for me.

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: Aha, now this is my kind of environment. And look at this discerning arrangement of shops.

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: I'm impressed, my young apprentice. Perhaps you're more of a business genius than I realized?

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: The next time that I, the renowned Lord Sangemah Bay, am negotiating a major business deal, make sure you come along.
